doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Football and marching band in high school
summary: He played running back and recalls a touchdown called back.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Although you were a football fan.
Yes, I was a football fan.
Yeah, I played in high school.
From your build, I take it you were a running back.
Yeah. I made one touchdown, and it was called back.
In one of those things there’s a picture of him in a football uniform...in one of those disks that I gave you. You also played in the marching band for the same game.
